n, k = map(int, input().split())
p = list(map(float, input().split()))

cnt = sum(1 for x in p if x > 0.000001)

if cnt <= k:
    result = [1 if x > 0.000001 else 0 for x in p]
    print(' '.join(map(str, result)))
    exit()

N = len(p)
dp = [0.0] * (1 << N)
ans = [0.0] * N

dp[0] = 1.0

for mask in range(1 << N):
    sum_p = 0.0
    for i in range(N):
        if (mask >> i) & 1:
            sum_p += p[i]
    if sum_p >= 0.99999:
        continue
    for i in range(N):
        if ((mask >> i) & 1) == 0:
            dp[mask | (1 << i)] += dp[mask] * p[i] / (1 - sum_p)

for mask in range(1 << N):
    cnt = 0
    for i in range(N):
        if (mask >> i) & 1:
            cnt += 1
    if cnt != k:
        continue
    for i in range(N):
        if (mask >> i) & 1:
            ans[i] += dp[mask]

print(' '.join(f"{x:.13f}" for x in ans))
